'''''Clerodendrum splendens''''', the '''glory tree''' or '''flaming glorybower''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[genus]] ''[[Clerodendrum]]'' of the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Lamiaceae]], [[native plant|native]] to [[tropics|tropical]] Western Africa. 

==Description==
It is a twining [[evergreen]] [[vine|climber]], growing to {{convert|3|m}} or more, with [[panicle]]s of brilliant scarlet flowers in summer. 

==Cultivation==
With a minimum temperature of {{convert|10|C|F|abbr=on}},<ref>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=978-1405332965|pages=1136}}</ref> it requires the protection of glass during the winter months in most [[temperateness|temperate]] regions.

In cultivation this plant has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]]<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Clerodendrum splendens''|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/29544/Clerodendrum-splendens/Details | access-date=15 April 2020}}</ref> (confirmed 2017).<ref>{{cite web  | url= https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf | title = AGM Plants - Ornamental | date = July 2017 | page = 22 | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 24 January 2018}}</ref>
